paid.note: iad1 'Queue API Operations $0.60 per 1,000,000 Operations'; regionally priced. Sends with an idempotency key and push deliveries with max concurrency bill at 2x units. Optional surcharges deducted from credits: Custom Reporting $0.075 per 1,000 tag/user-ID/quota-entity writes and $5 per 1,000 reporting queries; team-wide Provider Allowlist $0.10 per 1,000 successful requests; team-wide Zero Data Retention $0.10 per 1,000 requests (per-request variants free). Trace Drains bill via Drains usage ($0.50/GB) with no Pro allowance. AI Gateway Credits are separate from the $20 Pro usage credit.

Hobby: 100 cron jobs per project, minimum interval once per day (more frequent expressions fail deployment), scheduling precision per-hour (±59 min).

paid.note: 'Cron jobs are included in all plans'; execution is billed as Fluid compute (vc.functions.*). Pro: 100 cron jobs per project, minimum interval once per minute, per-minute precision.

notes: All prices USD, excluding VAT/GST. Prices recorded are the lowest-tier region (iad1 Washington D.C.; also cle1/pdx1 for compute). Most meters are regionally priced; ranges are noted per meter (source: https://vercel.com/docs/pricing/regional-pricing).

Hobby commercial use: NOT permitted. 'Hobby teams are restricted to non-commercial personal use only. All commercial usage of the platform requires either a Pro or Enterprise plan.' Ads, payments, affiliate links, donations, and paid work on the site all count as commercial (https://vercel.com/docs/limits/fair-use-guidelines#commercial-usage).

Hobby overage behaviour: 'If you have a free Hobby account, you are limited to the usage caps and cannot purchase additional usage.' 'In most cases, if you exceed your usage limits on the Hobby plan, you will have to wait until 30 days have passed before you can use the feature again.' Vercel's KB adds that sustained usage past limits can lead to a paused deployment. Blob: access blocked until 30 days pass. Image Optimization: new transformations return 402 (no longer pauses deployments).

Hobby function limits (Fluid compute, default since 2025-04-23): default and max duration 300s (5 min); CPU config Standard only = 2 GB / 1 vCPU, not configurable (Vercel manages CPU with a minimum of 1 vCPU). Pro: 300s default, configurable to 800s, extended 1800s in beta; Standard or Performance (4 GB / 2 vCPU). Legacy non-Fluid projects (pre 2025-04-23): Hobby 10s default / 60s max; Pro 15s / 300s. Middleware on the edge runtime is limited to 50 ms average CPU (fair-use). Hobby build: 2 vCPU / 8 GB, 1 concurrent build, 100 deployments/day, 200 projects.

Pro billing model: $20/month platform fee includes 1 deploying seat and $20/month of usage credit; extra Owner/Member seats $20/month each, Viewer seats free. The ONLY explicit per-meter Pro allowances are 1 TB Fast Data Transfer and 10,000,000 Edge Requests per month; every other meter is billed on demand and first drawn from the $20 credit. Simulators should model 'paid.included: 0' meters as covered by a shared $20 credit pool, not as free. Credit expires monthly. Spend Management (opt-in) can pause projects at a set spend amount.

Data-conflict flag: the Blob pricing example on docs (https://vercel.com/docs/vercel-blob/usage-and-pricing#pricing-example) still cites Pro per-meter allowances (5 GB storage, 100K simple ops, 10K advanced ops, 100 GB blob transfer, 100 GB Fast Origin Transfer) that vercel.com/pricing and the Pro plan page no longer list (credit-based since the 'Included Pro usage is now credit-based' change). Those meters are marked unverified with included 0.

Firewall: DDoS mitigation, IP blocking, custom rules (log/deny/challenge/bypass), and Attack Challenge Mode are free on Hobby and Pro with no per-request charge; mitigated traffic does not incur Edge Requests or Fast Data Transfer. Priced WAF features: rate limiting (Hobby 1M allowed requests/month included, 1 rule; Pro usage-based $0.50/1M allowed, iad1) and OWASP CRS managed ruleset (Enterprise). BotID Basic free on all plans; BotID Deep Analysis Pro-only at $1 per 1,000 checkBotId() calls. Bot Protection managed ruleset is stated as free for all users in the Vercel changelog (not a docs/pricing page).

Additional metered resources not in this file: Image cache reads (Hobby 300K, $0.40/1M) and writes (Hobby 100K, $4.00/1M); Edge Request CPU Duration ($0.30/hour iad1, Pro 1 hour included); Runtime Cache reads/writes (same rates as ISR); Build CPU minutes ($0.0035/CPU-min, Hobby builds free); Global Config reads $3/1M, writes $10/1K; Web Analytics (Hobby 50K events, Pro $0.03/1K); Speed Insights; Observability Plus $1.20/1M events; Private Data Transfer $0.15/GB.

URL notes: https://vercel.com/docs/pricing/networking redirects to https://vercel.com/docs/manage-cdn-usage (explanatory only, no prices); https://vercel.com/docs/incremental-static-regeneration/usage-and-pricing returned 404 and the live page is https://vercel.com/docs/incremental-static-regeneration/limits-and-pricing; Attack Challenge Mode is documented at https://vercel.com/docs/vercel-firewall/attack-mode. Hobby ISR included amounts (1M reads, 200K writes) and Hobby Blob included amounts come from https://vercel.com/pricing; the ISR docs page itself lists no per-plan allowances.

Marketplace storage (Neon Postgres, Upstash Redis, Supabase, AWS Aurora, Prisma Postgres): provisioned from the Vercel dashboard or 'vercel install', with 'Unified billing: Pay for storage resources through your Vercel account'; plans and prices are set by the provider and are not published in Vercel docs, so vc.kv.commands and vc.postgres.compute_hrs are null/unverified.

Edge Config was renamed Global Config (https://vercel.com/docs/global-config: 'Global Config was previously called Edge Config'); the /docs/edge-config/* URLs redirect to /docs/global-config/*. Pricing conflict: the Global Config limits page lists 'Global Config Writes $5.00' with no unit, while docs/limits says '$10 per 1K writes' and vercel.com/pricing says '$1 per 100 writes'; vc.edge_config.writes uses $10/1K and is marked unverified. Hobby allowances (100K reads, 100 writes per month) come from vercel.com/pricing only.

Routing Middleware (formerly Edge Middleware): https://vercel.com/docs/routing-middleware/limits and /docs/routing-middleware/usage-and-pricing both return 404; the live page https://vercel.com/docs/routing-middleware states it 'is priced using the fluid compute model', so there is no standalone middleware invocation meter and vc.middleware.invocations is recorded with pricePer 0 as a pointer to vc.functions.*.

Vercel Sandbox: https://vercel.com/docs/vercel-sandbox/pricing redirects to https://vercel.com/docs/sandbox/pricing. Hobby allowances are 5 CPU-hours, 420 GB-hours, 5,000 creations, 20 GB data transfer, 15 GB lifetime snapshot storage per month; Pro is fully usage-based against the $20 credit at iad1 rates $0.128/CPU-hr, $0.0212/GB-hr, $0.60/1M creations, $0.15/GB transfer, $0.08/GB-month snapshots.

Queues and Workflows: Vercel Queues (public beta) bills per API operation in 4 KiB chunks at $0.60/1M (iad1, regional); Hobby includes 1M operations/month per vercel.com/pricing. Vercel Workflows bills Workflow Events ($0.02/1K, Hobby 50K/month), Workflow Data Written ($0.50/GB, Hobby 1 GB) and Workflow Data Retained ($0.50/GB-month, not on Hobby); a normal step produces 3 events. Both also incur normal Fluid compute charges for the functions they invoke, and Workflows additionally consumes Queue operations.

Observability/analytics: https://vercel.com/docs/observability/limits-and-pricing redirects to https://vercel.com/docs/observability/observability-plus. Observability Plus ($1.20/1M events) is enabled by default for teams that became Paid Pro on or after 2026-04-03. Speed Insights on-demand events ($0.65/10K) require the Speed Insights Plus add-on ($10/project/month); without it the shared 10K/30-day allowance is a hard cap with a 14-day ingestion pause. Web Analytics Plus is a $10/month team add-on that does not change the $0.03/1K event rate.

AI Gateway is not a Vercel-metered resource: tokens are billed at provider list price with zero markup (including BYOK) from a prepaid AI Gateway Credits balance that is separate from the $20 Pro usage credit. The free tier's monthly credit amount is not published on the pricing page (recorded as unknown). Optional team-wide surcharges (Custom Reporting, Provider Allowlist, ZDR) are listed in the vc.ai_gateway.requests note.
